### New
- **Display options for every app.** A new **Display** section, in simple and template mode, covers the rest of the AWTRIX app settings: display time, scroll count and speed, icon behavior while scrolling, capitals, centering, text at the top, text offset, rainbow, two-color gradient, blinking or fading text, background color, background effects with their speed, palette and blending, weather overlays, what happens when the lifetime runs out, and keeping the app after a restart. In template mode they are defaults: keys set by the template win.
- **Order of the apps.** The new **Order** page lists the clock's whole loop, built-in apps and apps from other sources included, and lets you rearrange it by dragging or with arrows. The clock keeps following that order: an app that comes back after being hidden returns to its place. AWTRIX only reorders apps over HTTP, so this needs the clock's web page to be reachable, like animated icons.
- The preview now shows rainbow and gradient text and text at the top, and names the background effect it cannot animate.
